Name: Woodland Deer mount
Author: maplepixel
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/173726358-1772821598.png[/img]

I've created my first mod for the Stardew Valley Modfest 2026 to celebrate it's 10th year anniversary! I've been wanting to start modding for this game for a while, but never got round to it - this felt like the perfect time!

Thank you to ConcernedApe and all the team behind this very loved farming game. Hopefully this is a good contender for the Wildlife Team.
Special thank you to Em (Rivalrabbit) for all of your help, guidance and patience.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/173726358-1772825076.png[/img]

This mod replaces the horse with a deer (stag). I hope you love him just as much as I do. This mod also gets rid of the reins, and readjusts the seated riding sprite and the arms/hands ever so slightly. 

Download and install both [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].
Download "Woodland Deer mount" and unzip the folder.
Place the folder in your Stardew Valley mods folder. 
﻿- [i]If you're using Alternative Textures, use the 'Scissors' item that you buy from Robin's Store, left click on the horse and select the Woodland Deer texture in the pop-up menu.[/i]
Hopefully it all works your end - let me know! 

Thank you so much for downloading my mod, I really hope you enjoy it! [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/173726358-1772824653.png[/img]



Updates:
